name: Sure smile, fists set
note: Eyes straight ahead under set brows, a firm closed smile, fists clenched at his sides. White tee, black shoes.

name: Gritted grin, leaning in
note: Teeth clenched in a grin, leaning into his stride like he is late for something great. Cream tee, white sneakers.

name: Half smile, this way
note: One brow up, half a smile, finger raised: he has the plan. Pale blue tee, white sneakers.

name: Dead serious, nose puff
note: A tiny pressed mouth and a puff of breath from his nose: far too serious for his size. Mint tee, black shoes.
